metadata.description: Agent Skills marketplace by Nekko Labs: official and community-contributed Claude skills. Browse them with a workflow graph each at https://vaizer.app/skills

plugins.name: vaizer
plugins.description: The Nekko Labs skill collection, installed as one plugin: codereview-spec (spec conformance), nyaa (a five-cat review council), domain-finder (naming and domain availability), and resume-checker (ATS and AI-role screening). Each is invoked as /vaizer:<skill>.
